title: Certificate of the band addressing of layer-1 limit-zero disks
rigor_note: All output intervals are directed Arb balls (strict); floats are reflections only. Address = attribute of the certified localisation disk (criterion A: fingerprint at the exact certified centre).
criterion: A (exact certified centre; directed Arb point acb)

convention.fingerprint: arg(x_{2^m}) mod 180deg, x_{n+1}=g(w)+s*h(w), w=(x^2-1)/r_disc, x_0=0, s=u*AU0/delta^m; x_{2^m} half-point
convention.coeffs_source: w33/t5_cert_sonnet/w33_gh_hiprec.json (M=100 Chebyshev) via w35/x4_walk_sonnet/x4_common.py cheb_to_taylor recipe

objects.conditional_note: Z60, Z57 carry a CONDITIONAL address: their disk winding(H7)=1 is certified, but limit status awaits point 14; the address becomes unconditional once point 14 is accepted.
objects.addendum_15_4_note: Z72 is now certified by point 17 (shifted disk D(4.758336330290482+7.1277051021354385i, rho=0.1), final_verdict.limit_status_H_proven=True) and receives address IV.4; status limit_proven_via_point17.

theorem_A_band_decomposition.statement: Within each band neighbouring fingerprints go in the declared order; the five inter-band gaps are strictly positive, each exceeds its declared floor and the max inside-band step; all 23 fingerprint intervals are pairwise disjoint.

theorem_B_index.statement: Within each band, k is the order by |centre| of the certified disk centre (Arb); |c_i| < |c_j| strictly for every k-neighbouring pair.

NC1a_largest_gap_V_VI.description: fingerprint value at midpoint of the largest inter-band gap (V<->VI)

NC1b_gap_III_IV.description: fingerprint value at midpoint of the III<->IV gap (~50 deg example)

NC2_Z19_duplicate.description: point = centre(Z19) + 1e-9 (real); must share band IV + neighbourhood
